description: Use this when a user asks what agricultural land (farmland, arable land or grassland) sells for, or what it costs to rent, per hectare in EU member states and Norway, in a particular region of such a country, or how it changed since the year before. Returns the official average price per hectare (or the average rent per hectare for one year) for the latest year published, in the currency the answer states (euro and national currency where the source gives both), for the chosen land type (arable, permanent grassland and others), the previous year and change, the history, the other land types, the regions that exist, and the official source and licence. This is a published average (price_type official_statistic), not a range built from sales, so the range fields are null and there is no sample size. How fresh: annual. Eurostat publishes land data with a lag of about two years (on 2026-10-14 the newest year is 2024) and some countries are further behind; each answer states its reference year and flags old figures. Always read the reference year in the answer: the data are about two years behind and some countries are much older. Do not use for the value of a particular field or farm, for house or building land or commercial property, for listings or asking prices, or for other countries.

country.description: EU member states and Norway, as ISO codes (GR for Greece): AT = Austria, BE = Belgium, BG = Bulgaria, HR = Croatia, CZ = Czechia, DK = Denmark, EE = Estonia, FI = Finland, FR = France, GR = Greece, HU = Hungary, IE = Ireland, IT = Italy, LV = Latvia, LT =…

land_type.description: Land type, e.g. 'arable', 'permanent grassland', 'arable or grassland' (rent only), 'irrigable arable' (price only). Leave out for the usual one. EU/NO, optional. For price: "arable" = Arable land; "permanent grassland" = Permanent…

measure.description: price = what agricultural land sells for per hectare; rent = what it costs to rent per hectare for one year. EU/NO: price = average sale price of agricultural land per hectare (Eurostat apri_lprc); rent = average rent for one year per…

region.description: Optional region code for a regional figure, where the source publishes one (the country notes say which codes). Leave out for the whole country. EU/NO, optional. A NUTS region code (Eurostat's regional land data), e.g. ES51 = Cataluña…
